content.value: The World Tree is a secondary skill tree focused on gathering, exploration, and out-of-combat utility. Unlike the Passive Tree which uses combat experience, the World Tree uses its own XP system tied to in-world activities.

World Tree points are earned through various gathering activities: mining ores, chopping wood, fishing, farming, and exploring new areas. Each activity has its own XP multiplier and contribution rate.

World Tree nodes provide bonuses like:
• Increased mining speed for specific ore types
• Better crop yields and growth rates
• Enhanced fishing loot tables
• Movement speed in specific biomes
• Reduced fall damage
• Improved experience gain from gathering
Press O to open the World Tree directly, or navigate to it through the Compendium sidebar. The tree uses the same zoom and pan controls as the Passive Tree — scroll to zoom, click and drag to pan.
The World Tree is completely separate from the Passive Tree. You can invest in both simultaneously, and neither affects the other's progression.
